notes.title: A major bug in the beta version has been fixed
notes.notes: [p]The product launch just kicked off, and then the game crashed... Upon careful inspection, it turned out that a feature under development triggered a bug in the deployed game, halting the gameplay. Consequently, an urgent fix was made, and the update is now complete. Learning from this experience, I'll never mix development and deployment versions again. Indeed, developing a game single-handedly is quite challenging...[/p]
